signature_items.item: spade-suit card tabards with rank indices Three, Four, Six, Eight, Nine, Ten of Spades (never Two, Five or Seven — those belong to the named gardeners; never any club rank — the whole club suit belongs to the card soldiers and the visiting Clubs monarchs)
signature_items.reason: Keeps numerals unique so the named trio stays identifiable. BIB-0029 (DEF-p4-char-301) moved the gardeners from clubs to spades. The source names the gardeners' numbers but never their suit, while ch008-p11 'ten soldiers carrying clubs' anchors the club suit to the soldiers; the club suit has only thirteen cards and ten soldiers plus the King and Queen of Clubs (CHAR-visiting-monarchs-ensemble M01/M02) already fill twelve of them, so no club rank was left for a gardener. Spades also fit garden staff. The numeral -- the only thing the source fixes and the only thing that identifies the figure on screen -- is unchanged. Sheet note: the H2-locked sheet draws club trefoils; under reroll budget 0 it was not regenerated, so costumes.json visual_en is the pip authority for prompts (runs/g4/gate.json DEF-p4-costume-sheet-901 waiver).
